Definition: a hump or peak of hills
BiblicalUsage: Gabnon is the hump or peak of a hill, the high places that rise above the plain. The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan, an high hill, in Psalms 68:15, and the psalm asks why the high hills leap in Psalms 68:16. This is the hill God desires to dwell in, and the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God chooses high places for His dwelling, and the hills themselves seem to leap at the thought; the hill of Bashan is high, but God's hill is higher, and I hold that He dwells with His people for ever.
